metadata.author: Jacqueline Harvey
metadata.description: Join Willa and her loyal dog Woof in two delightful adventures! First, Willa’s creative plan for Grandparents’ Day hits some bumps, and she must find a way to make it a success. Then, when a bushfire threatens her Aunty Jane’s wedding, Willa jumps into action to save the big day.
